subject.title: feat(claude): add claude-bridge app-server harness extension

question: Should this provider-managed Claude harness ship as a bundled OpenClaw extension with an OpenClaw-owned bridge package, or remain an external plugin/ClawHub integration using generic SDK seams?
rationale: The implementation can be reshaped either way, but selecting a permanent package, security, auth, state, and owner boundary is a maintainer product decision rather than a mechanical repair.

options.title: Externalize the harness
options.body: Move Claude and GLM bridge behavior to independently packaged plugin/ClawHub surfaces and request only narrowly justified generic SDK seams.

options.title: Adopt a bundled implementation
options.body: Require an OpenClaw-owned or independently security-reviewed bridge package, canonical SQLite state, and a generic plugin contract before accepting the bundled path.

options.title: Decline this harness direction
options.body: Keep existing provider, CLI, and ACP paths as the supported Claude integrations and close the PR after documenting the chosen route.

recommendation.title: Externalize the harness
recommendation.body: Move Claude and GLM bridge behavior to independently packaged plugin/ClawHub surfaces and request only narrowly justified generic SDK seams.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch history records product-shape direction from Eddie, while the linked issue explicitly requests a maintainer decision.
